LanguageData.WotF_Scenario_Elf_GameStartDialog:
Whether drawn by a longing for the outside world or parted from the others by quiet disagreement, the three of you packed what you could carry and left the settlement you had called home for years.

After a long trek, you have come to a halt in an untamed land unrecorded in any old book. Far from the old rules and disputes, whatever lies ahead is yours alone to face.

A new story begins here.
